item_name: Uniform Assessment System for NY (UAS-NY) Does Not Meet Requirements
lookback_notes: NOT_FOUND. The protocol's Area 12 entry states no observation/look-back window for the UAS-NY assessment. It states only that finalization must occur "within a timely manner" without defining a day count. (A 7-day look-back appears elsewhere in the document, at Area 30, but that applies to the Patient Review Instrument for service dates prior to 03/01/2015, not to the UAS-NY.)

federal_coding_rules.rule: The UAS-NY must meet the following requirements for Assisted Living Program residents: assessments are conducted in-person; completed by registered professional nurse; assessor's information is accurate; includes a completed Functional Supplement; generated RUGS Group Code; finalization within a timely manner.

source.quote: The Uniform Assessment System for NY (UAS-NY) must meet the following requirements for Assisted Living Program residents: • assessments are conducted in-person • completed by  registered professional nurse • assessor's information is accurate • includes a completed Functional Supplement • generated RUGS Group Code • finalization within a timely manner

federal_coding_rules.rule: Claims will be disallowed if the UAS-NY does not meet the listed requirements.

source.quote: Claims will be disallowed if the UAS-NY does not meet the requirements.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Service-date-specific authority applies: for services 05/25/18 and after, 18 NYCRR § 494.4(h) governs; for services 03/17/93 through 05/24/18, 18 NYCRR § 494.4(g) governs.

case_mix_relevance.notes: The protocol requires the UAS-NY to have a generated RUGS Group Code and cites the DOH memo on Generating RUG III Scores and Calculating Hours of Formal Care; RUG grouping underlies ALP rate determination. The document does not otherwise explicitly tie Area 12 to a payment classification (rate code issues are handled under separate Area 13).
